registers.name: CTRL
registers.description: Control register for mode enable, optional slew limiting, and sticky fault acknowledge.

registers.name: TIMEOUT_LIMIT
registers.description: Programmable freshness timeout threshold in clock cycles.

fields.name: timeout_limit
fields.description: Freshness timeout limit, applied as a 16-bit cycle count.

registers.name: CLAMP_MIN
registers.description: Minimum allowed actuator command after sanitization.

fields.name: min_cmd
fields.description: Lower clamp bound for actuator command sanitization.

registers.name: CLAMP_MAX
registers.description: Maximum allowed actuator command after sanitization.

fields.name: max_cmd
fields.description: Upper clamp bound for actuator command sanitization.

registers.name: SLEW_LIMIT
registers.description: Maximum allowed per-cycle delta when slew limiting is enabled.

registers.name: STATUS
registers.description: Current acceptance and safety status snapshot.

registers.name: TELEMETRY
registers.description: Compact telemetry/status word mirrored from the streaming status packet.

sources.name: FAULT_IRQ
sources.description: Asserted when sticky fault state is present and visible to firmware.

init_sequence: Write CTRL with mode_enable=0, slew_enable as desired, and fault_ack=1 only if clearing a prior sticky fault.
Program TIMEOUT_LIMIT with a suitable freshness threshold.
Program CLAMP_MIN and CLAMP_MAX with sanitized actuator bounds.
Program SLEW_LIMIT if slew limiting is enabled.
Write CTRL with mode_enable=1 to allow validated commands to be accepted.
polling_sequence: Read STATUS to monitor accept_code, stale_flag, watchdog_expired, inhibit_flag, clamp_applied, current_mode, sticky_fault, and last_sequence.
Read TELEMETRY for compact mirrored status information.
If sticky_fault is set, write CTRL.fault_ack=1 and re-read STATUS.
irq_sequence: On FAULT_IRQ assertion, service firmware fault handling.
Read STATUS to capture the rejection cause and current safety state.
Acknowledge the sticky fault through CTRL.fault_ack if software determines the condition is cleared.

consistency_notes: All assumptions remain compatible with DIGITAL_SPEC_JSON.
The MMIO map is real and reachable through explicit CSR decode.
No AXI, APB, or other incompatible bus is implied.
Register bit ranges use lsb <= msb ordering.
No fallback command or substitute actuator behavior is introduced.
